summary: Step-by-step implementation plan for the 3D Digital Twin & Photogrammetry Workbench in ESWA GEOLOGICAL MAPPER, supporting single/multi-photo 3D rock surface reconstruction, calibrated photo-draping across Tunnel, Vertical Shaft, and Surface domains, 4-method Dip Direction/Dip Amount extraction (3-point/polygon facet click, 2D trace-to-3D relief projection, multi-photo cross-surface triangulation, and automated rock facet normal clustering), continuous multi-round chainage stitching, and zero-lag sync with the 3D Joint Inspector.
